mandate: Owner request 2026-10-16: "Can we add a help page to list keyboard shortcuts." Help > Keyboard Shortcuts plus a conventional key, grouped, searchable, native key text, scoped and typing notes, generated from the real bindings with a drift test, theme-aware, accessible, 100/125/200%, resizable, Esc closes; Qt presentation only. Fresh short attended session, one Accept/Reject with Light and Dark renders; do not merge before acceptance.
governing_rfc: RFC-BPR-0028 (review workbench and its keys); RFC-BPR-0033 and BPR-0796 (resident desktop menu bar mirrors the window's menus disabled); BPR-1250 (Help menu)

decisions.key: Ctrl+/ (Command-/): the shortcut-list key in Slack and Google's editors; Command-? is macOS's Help-menu search; no Qt standard key, text widget or other binding uses Ctrl+/ (asserted). On layouts where / needs Shift the menu item remains the way in.
decisions.single_source: Static catalogue in the Qt adapter (keyboard_shortcuts.cpp). Every binding site in the window, resident menu bar, epoch control, tour editor, strip, Overview, Settings, thread finder, comment card and Review Cycle view/sheets takes its keys from it; the page is generated from it. The drift test enumerates live QAction/QShortcut/explicit button keys.
decisions.handler_keys: Keys read in widgets' own key handlers (Return in code, Cmd-L label menu, Find query Alt-W/Alt-L) are catalogue entries but invisible to enumeration; documented in the UX spec.
decisions.behaviour_changes: Resident bar's Previous/Next change now also carry Alt+PgUp/Alt+PgDown like the window's; its Find and navigation items gained object names; Settings key on the resident bar is Ctrl+, (was QKeySequence::Preferences, identical on macOS, the only platform constructing it).
